POSITIVE_FIXTURES.name: Malmö/Malmo + Triangeln/Triangle + ordinal + dash (benches/b1/point_two)
POSITIVE_FIXTURES.canonical: Malmö’s Triangeln station opened in December 2010, and a formal complaint about its tilted bench was reported on March 4, 2011. Yet officials said it was steeper than ordered and later corrected. In 2021, an NYC Transit post linked bench removals to homeless people sleeping. It was deleted, and the MTA called it an error—not a confirmed policy.
POSITIVE_FIXTURES.asr: Malmo's Triangle station opened in December 2010, and a formal complaint about its tilted bench was reported on March 4th, 2011. Yet officials said it was steeper than ordered and later corrected. In 2021, an NYC Transit post linked bench removals to homeless people sleeping. It was deleted and the MTA called it an error, not a confirmed policy.
